```{r}
#| label: tbl-rd02-selected-species-estimates
#| echo: false
#| tbl-cap: "Regeneration basal area 10 years after harvest for all four species categories. Entries are arithmetic mean (lower, upper 95% confidence limits), in m^2^ ha^-1^. Each category was modeled separately using zero-inflated Gamma responses, treatment as a fixed effect, and site and macro-plot-within-site random intercepts. Redwood zero probability varies by treatment; other categories retain constant zero probabilities. No zero-component random effects are retained. Means include modeled zeros and integrate over both positive-component random-effect distributions. Intervals use the full-parameter log-scale delta method and describe uncertainty in means. Each model uses 64 vegetation plots across four sites and 16 macro plots. GS = group selection; LD = low-density dispersed retention; HA = high-density aggregated retention; HD = high-density dispersed retention."

# tbl-rd02-selected-species-estimates
rd02_selected_table <- read.csv(
  "outputs/regeneration/selected-species-models/tables/rd02-selected-species-display.csv",
  check.names = FALSE
)
readRDS("outputs/helpers/task-helpers.rds")$publication_table(rd02_selected_table)
```
